title: Custom Hooks and Code Organization
description: Learn how to create custom hooks to reuse logic across components and organize your React code for better maintainability.

lessons.title: What are Custom Hooks?
lessons.content: Custom hooks are JavaScript functions that start with 'use' and allow you to extract reusable logic from components.

lessons.title: Creating a Simple Custom Hook
Using Custom Hooks in Components
Benefits of Custom Hooks
lessons.content:
- Code reuse
- Cleaner components
- Better separation of concerns
- Easier testing

lessons.title: Organizing Hooks by Feature
lessons.content: Group custom hooks inside a dedicated folder, e.g., `/hooks/`, and organize them by features or domains for clarity.

lessons.title: Organizing Components by Type
lessons.content: Structure components in folders by their purpose: `common/` for reusable components, `pages/` for route components, and `features/` for feature-specific UI.

lessons.title: Using Barrel Files for Cleaner Imports
lessons.content: Create `index.js` files inside folders to re-export components/hooks for simpler and cleaner imports.

lessons.title: Separation of Concerns in React
lessons.content: Keep UI, logic, and data fetching separate using custom hooks, presentational and container components, and services.

lessons.title: Example: Custom Hook for Fetching Data
Best Practices for Code Organization
lessons.content:
- Use feature-based folders
- Keep components small and focused
- Write reusable hooks
- Maintain consistent naming conventions
- Document your code
